decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The building hereby permitted shall not be used at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 66 Strand On The Green, Chiswick, London W4 3PF. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until an Arboricultural Method Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The statement must describe how demolition, excavation and construction activity is to be managed in order to protect the existing tree on the adjacent property (No. 65 Strand on the Green, London W4). This statement shall include details and specifications, for protective fencing, foundations and structural plans, ground level changes, Tree Protection Zones, a timetable of works, material storage areas, supervision and schedule of work methods with regard to BS 5837:2005.
description: Erection of a two storey semi-detached building comprising a games room and bin store at ground floor and a bedroom with toilet and shower at first floor. (Amended description)
